fields.description: Initial term (§9.1). A fixed year term auto-derives End Date from Start Date in validate(); Month-to-Month/Other leave it manual.

fields.description: For a fixed year term this is derived from Start Date; the daily scheduler marks the contract Expired once it passes. Blank never expires.
fields.label: End Date

fields.description: For fountains that are drained for winter. A regular visit that would fall between the 1st of the Winterization Month and the Startup Month moves to the 1st of the Startup Month, and finishing the Winterization visit moves every feature there too. Leave unticked for fountains that keep running over winter.
fields.label: Pause Regular Visits Over Winter

fields.description: The commercial Sales Order. Per-visit invoices are drawn against it.
fields.label: Sales Order

fields.description: Per Visit auto-drafts a Sales Invoice on each submitted visit. Monthly/Quarterly/Annually are billed in arrears by the recurring-billing job (base Recurring Amount + rolled-up consumables) when "Recurring Maintenance Billing" is enabled in Settings.
fields.label: Invoicing Frequency

fields.description: The agreement's base labor rate per visit. Chemicals are billed in addition. Rises by the Annual Increase at each automatic renewal, and a per-visit invoice bills at this rate when it is set.
fields.label: Base Rate (per visit)

fields.description: Flat base billed each period (§4.2). Auto-filled from the linked agreement's Annual Fee ÷ cadence when blank; overridable. Rolled-up consumables from the period's visits are added on top.
fields.label: Recurring Amount (per period)

fields.description: A seasonal agreement's first billed month, e.g. May for "service starts May 1st through September 30th, billed monthly". Leave Bill From and Bill Through blank to bill all year. A Monthly or Quarterly period is billed when at least half its days fall in these months, on or after the Start Date; outside them only the chemicals used are invoiced.
fields.label: Bill From

fields.description: When the next recurring invoice is due (end of the current period). Blank = not yet on recurring billing. Advances when a period is drafted; if you discard a recurring draft, reset this manually so the period re-bills.
fields.label: Next Billing Date

fields.description: The signed Maintenance Services Agreement this operational contract executes.
fields.label: Project Contract

fields.description: Copied from the signed agreement (§4.3). A card is optional; one method must be on file.
fields.label: Payment Method on File
fields.options:
Credit / Debit Card
Bank Account (ACH)
Invoice (Check or Bank Transfer)
Other

fields.description: Per hour, business hours (§8.2). Rises with the Annual Increase at renewal.
fields.label: Emergency Rate (per hour)

fields.description: Per hour, evenings, weekends and holidays (§8.2). Rises with the Annual Increase at renewal.
fields.label: After-Hours Emergency Rate (per hour)

fields.description: §9.2 — auto-renew for successive one-year terms at term end. Requires "Auto-Renew Maintenance Contracts" in Settings; otherwise the contract expires at End Date.
fields.label: Auto-Renew at Term End

fields.description: At each automatic renewal the base rate, the recurring amount and both emergency rates rise by this much (§9.2). A contract made from a signed agreement takes its figure (12% is the standard). One with no agreement behind it starts at 0, since nothing signed allows an increase; set one by hand where it was agreed. 0 renews at the same rates, as every contract that existed before v1.611.0 does.
fields.label: Annual Increase at Renewal (%)

fields.description: Either party gave 30-day non-renewal notice (§9.2). When set, the contract expires at End Date instead of auto-renewing.
fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Given

fields.description: §4.5 — a scheduled new per-visit rate. Accounts is reminded 30 days before the effective date; staff send the client written notice and update the Sales Order rate. Advisory only — nothing auto-changes billing.
fields.label: Scheduled New Rate (per visit)

fields.description: Per Feature: one visit form per water feature. Per Site Visit: one form covers all covered features, with per-feature rows inside it.
fields.label: Visit Shape

fields.description: Used for covered features that don't set their own template.
fields.label: Default Form Template

fields.description: Blank = the contract's default template.
fields.label: Startup Form Template

fields.description: Blank = the contract's default template.
fields.label: Winterization Form Template

fields.description: Unusual annual one-off visits beyond the standard startup/winterization pair, drafted when their target month arrives.
fields.label: Custom Seasonal Visits
